statement: Let public visitors discover Topgolf venues and let local guests or phone-verified customers review, confirm, and manage simulated bay reservations without external effects.
simulations: Phone verification stays local and sends no SMS.
All payment outcomes use local-sandbox and accept no payment credentials.
All reservations affect only the site-bound local SQLite database.
out_of_scope: Source slot holds, bookings, changes, or cancellations
Real SMS, email, payments, messages, reviews, push, PR, or deployment
Email/password registration, password recovery, ratings, reviews, and generalized sorting
Claims of source checkout or confirmation visual fidelity
